summary: Green Circle Decarbonize Technology Limited, a Cayman-incorporated, Hong Kong-based energy-saving solutions provider listed on the NYSE under GCDT, furnished a Form 6-K on October 15, 2026, disclosing a press release about preliminary, non-binding discussions with WinS Management and Company to explore green-industry and infrastructure projects in Japan, potentially applying its decarbonization technologies to a luxury hotel and villa development in Karuizawa. The parties estimate the total contract sum, if successful, could exceed HKD 100 million; no definitive agreement exists and no board recommendation or advisor was named. This is an ordinary business-development announcement, not a special situation, though the disclosure-driven stock reaction and any definitive pact or WinS financing terms warrant monitoring.
